title: 北京动物园扩建总图 / Beijing Zoo Expansion Master Plan

coordinateSystem.origin: unchanged centre of the existing zoo scene
coordinateSystem.y: +y is up; outdoor grade is y=0.000
coordinateSystem.yaw: 0 faces +z; PI/2 faces +x; PI faces -z; -PI/2 faces -x
coordinateSystem.rectangles: x0 < x1 and z0 < z1; bounds are inclusive wall lines

engineContract.canonicalSourceRule: All coordinates must be compiled from this blueprint or its eventual JS equivalent. Do not duplicate habitat rectangles in data.js.
engineContract.collisionRule: Visible walls, body solids and camera blockers use the same opening intervals.
engineContract.tagRule: Every tagged prop resolves to a local thing with the same tag; repeated benches each own their own thing and focus.
engineContract.routeRule: Every route segment is sampled against compiled clampMove at its actor radius before release.
engineContract.stableChildIdRule: Ordered child geometry uses <parent-id>/G## for ground layers and <parent-id>/O## for habitat objects; changing order is a geometry revision.
engineContract.fixtureThingRule: Every tagged objectSchedule record carries its own thingId, focus and reach; repeated visible tags therefore resolve to the nearest local thing.
engineContract.geometryHashRule: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON geometry payload defined and recomputed by zoo-blueprint-check.js; coordinates may not change without revision and hash changes.
engineContract.buildingWallRule: For every ground-level building derive BW-<building-id>-x0|x1|z0|z1 from footprint, default thickness 0.20m, and subtract each door interval from visible/body/camera layers; B01 and B07 provide explicit segment overrides.

habitatBarrierSystem.sideIdRule: HW-<habitat-id>-x0|x1|z0|z1; each side is the matching bounds line and spans the other bounds pair.
habitatBarrierSystem.openingIdRule: HG-<habitat-id>-service|public-##|animal-##; subtract centre ± width/2 from visible, keeper-body and camera-blocker runs.
habitatBarrierSystem.playerCollision: The habitat bounds rectangle is player-solid except for explicit publicAccessZones. Subtract only those zones and their owning public-gate openings from the player collider; service and animal gates remain player-solid.
habitatBarrierSystem.keeperCollision: Keepers collide with derived perimeter runs, not the player-only rectangle, so declared openings are traversable.
habitatBarrierSystem.cameraCollision: Derived perimeter runs use archetype.cameraBlockerTop; zero means no blocker.

animalTransferCrossings.operation: after-hours only; close public path gates before opening both animal gates

accessibleTour.rule: Use only paths with accessible=true; visit the focus of every public outdoor habitat and every public building entrance; maximum running slope 1:20, maximum cross slope 1:50, rest point every 45m.

interactions.habitatRule: Compile every habitatThings record as one visible interpretation board and one local thing. Mixed habitats therefore expose every listed species independently; board and thing share hz as their visible tag.

graphics.artDirection: A civic Chinese garden with distinct ecological districts, not a uniform grid of concrete pens.

lighting.nightRule: no point light may be placed inside an animal eye line; use path-verge pools and lit signs

performanceBudgets.rule: Do not construct every district merely because data.js needs habitat bounds; keep blueprint data eager and render builders lazy.

validation: Every ID is unique and every reference resolves.
Every number is finite, grid-aligned and inside its declared scene bounds.
Every wall opening cuts visible geometry, body solid and camera blocker by the identical interval.
No habitat overlaps another habitat, protected path envelope or building footprint.
Every public path is connected to both public spawns and is at least 1.8m wide after collider inflation.
Every accessible path is at least 2.0m wide, has no steps, and connects every accessible destination.
Every habitat focus is outside its habitat solid, inside its viewing path envelope, standable and reachable.
Every tag exists on a visible prop and resolves to the nearest local thing with the same tag.
Every animal slot is inside its habitat after the species radius inset and matches its substrate.
Every keeper route enters a habitat only through its declared service gate.
Every route segment is sampled at 0.05m against compiled collision; loop closure is included.
Public routes never use staff paths; animal routes never leave their owning habitat.
All new headwords exist in vocab.js and all use actions resolve through USE_AT.zoo.
The Tropical House entrance and exit preserve place, coordinates, yaw, time and ticket state.
The scene stays within prop, batch, solid, blocker and active-light budgets.
Day, dusk, night, rain and four district-wide audit views show no z-fighting, floating objects, opaque path obstructions or mislabeled map orientation.
Old saves inside the original x=-22..22,z=-16..16 core reload at the identical position unless inside a removed wall solid.
The canonical geometry hash matches revision and changes whenever any placement-bearing field changes.
